title: Extended Care Health Option (ECHO) Covered Services and Authorization Standards
content:
The Extended Care Health Option (ECHO) covers the same range of services in all ten tiers, from Extended Care Health Option, Sponsor E-1 to E-5 through Extended Care Health Option, Sponsor O-9 and O-10, under the same authorization and case-management standards.

## Services ECHO covers (every tier)

| Service | Covered |
|---|---|
| Respite care | yes |
| ECHO Home Health Care | yes |
| Assistive services | yes |
| Durable equipment | yes |
| Training | yes |
| Institutional care | yes |
| Transportation | yes |
| Rehabilitative services | yes |

## Scope of particular benefits (every tier)

| Benefit | Covered |
|---|---|
| Training for the beneficiary and family | yes |
| Transportation to and from an ECHO-authorized institution | yes |
| Institutional care when residential care is medically or psychologically necessary | yes |
| Assistive services and technology | yes |
| ECHO durable equipment, including adaptations | yes |

## Authorization and case-management standards (every tier)

| Standard | Every tier |
|---|---|
| Every ECHO service needs its own authorization | yes |
| Months one ECHO service authorization covers | 6 |
| Public facility use certification required for services public facilities could provide | yes |
| Youngest age at which the certification applies | 3 years |
| Days between ECHO case-management reviews of the service plan | 90 |

## Points of application

- **One authorization per service.** An authorization for one ECHO service does not stand in for another service; each service needs its own.
- **Span of an authorization.** One ECHO service authorization covers 6 months.
- **The certification threshold.** For services public facilities could provide, the public facility use certification applies from age 3: a beneficiary aged 3 or older is within it, and a beneficiary aged 2 is below the age at which it applies.
- **Review of the plan.** The ECHO case manager reviews the service plan every 90 days.
